# How to Data Compression with Strings

Source: [5932](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/5932); edited 2025-05-11. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-5932-n1"></a>

- Encoding large static vectors/strings into Custom String data can reduce element count, with runtime parsing/decompression cost.

<a id="wiki-5932-n2"></a>

- Example format uses semicolon-separated typed records c/n/s/v, comma-separated vector components, numeric sign/decimal parsing, and subroutines; decoder yields through a Wait for each decoded item.

Source limitations:

- Example relies on compact Boolean/Null numeric coercions and unusual Skip/Else dispatch; not validated as a reusable parser.

- No escaping scheme for embedded delimiters, malformed-input handling, locale behavior, benchmarks or concurrency safety is supplied; shared global parser state is visible in code.
